## Plan

{
  "strategy": "Return to the estimator that holds the best ranking (hist_gbdt, attempt 2's regularised configuration) and spend this attempt on the ranking axis by widening the ensemble's effective capacity in the one direction attempt 2 never explored: many more, slower trees with per-tree feature<path> noise removed from the equation is not available here, so instead I lower learning_rate to 0.015 and raise max_iter to 2500 while keeping the regularisation that fixed the memorisation (max_leaf_nodes 31, max_depth 6, min_samples_leaf 40, l2_regularization 10.0), and I lift min_samples_leaf-level smoothing slightly by keeping l2 high. early_stopping stays false so all 27,126 train rows are fitted (attempt 2's condition, and the reason attempt 3's 24,413-row fit was not comparable). Preprocessing is unchanged and deliberately: impute:none with no scaling, and no missingness columns — the card reports missing_rate 0.0 on every column, the 'unknown' markers are ordinary one-hot levels, so missing_indicator<path> would be constant and buy nothing (this is where I depart from the Critic's direction). The imbalance lever moves one small notch back toward the measured crossing: class_weight {\"0\": 1, \"1\": 6.5}, bracketed by 1:6 (recall 0.7382 < specificity 0.9150) and 1:7 (recall 0.8488 > specificity 0.8760), which is where the mean of recall and specificity is maximised for a given ranking. Read roc_auc and balanced_accuracy_at_best_cut against attempt 2's 0.9351 / 0.8747: if the finer-grained boosting run raises at-best-cut above 0.8811 the remaining work is the weight; if it does not, the bar is out of reach of this executor's levers and 0.8624 stands as the run's best.",

  "changes_from_last": "Attempt 3 was xgboost with subsampling and 1500 unstopped trees on a 24,413-row fit; this attempt is hist_gbdt again, fitting all 27,126 rows (early_stopping false), and differs from attempt 2 — the previous best hist_gbdt run — in two numeric ways: learning_rate halved 0.03→0.015 and max_iter raised 900→2500 (a finer, longer boosting path at the same per-tree capacity and same l2 10.0), and class_weight moved from {\"0\":1,\"1\":7} to {\"0\":1,\"1\":6.5}, inside the bracket the two measured runs establish. It is not a repeat of any prior configuration. I do not add missing_count as the Critic directed: the card reports missing_rate 0.0 for all 16 columns and zero columns with missing values, so that column would be identically 0 for every row and the fit would be attempt 2 re-run — the 'unknown' text markers live inside the one-hot encoding, not as NaNs, and the executor cannot re-encode them into NaN.",
  "rationale": "The shortfall is on the ranking axis and it is small: attempt 2's cut_headroom is 0.0123 against 0.0187 remaining, and its balanced_accuracy_at_best_cut 0.8747 (KS 0.7494) is 0.0064 below the bar's required 0.7622, so no operating point on the current ranking reaches 0.8811. The family-swap lever has been tried and refuted (xgboost -0.0201 paired, at-best-cut 0.8747→0.8687), and the ledger prices family swaps at only 0.0022–0.0077 roc_auc against a 0.003–0.006 paired resolution, so another list family is a coin flip at best while the regularised hist_gbdt configuration already holds the best ranking measured here. The remaining untried ranking lever inside that configuration is the shrinkage<path> trade-off: attempt 1 (lr 0.06, 63 leaves) memorised, attempt 2 (lr 0.03, 31 leaves, l2 10) fixed that and gained +0.0358 with train_val_gap 0.0584, so capacity is now on the conservative side of the curve rather than the overfit side — halving the learning rate with ~2.8x the trees buys a smoother, higher-resolution decision function at the same regularisation, which is the plausible source of the 0.006–0.019 of ranking still needed. Cost is not binding: attempt 2 took 14.9 s of 600 s, and 2500 trees at 31 leaves should land near 40–50 s, well inside both the time and 2 GB memory limits. The weight nudge to 1:6.5 is a bounded, attributable second move: recall<path> crossed between 1:6 and 1:7, and balanced_accuracy is their mean, so the midpoint is the best available operating point on whatever ranking this fit produces — worth at most the reported headroom, which is why the main bet is on the boosting schedule. Preprocessing is held fixed so any change in roc_auc / balanced_accuracy_at_best_cut is attributable to the schedule alone.",

    "feature_engineering"
  ],
